GameConditionDef.label: Sanctuary Protocol
GameConditionDef.description: “When the world shudders and the void stirs, the Protocol awakens.” An ancient archotech failsafe — a machine whose origin predates written memory — has activated in response to unimaginable tragedy. Throughout the world, pockets of serenity blossom: poisoned land becomes fertile, broken minds find clarity, the dead stir in memory. Colonists whisper of a machine buried deep within the crust, a miracle engine of peace and recursion. Some call it salvation. Others call it a cage. The skies above ripple faintly, and psychic noise forms faint whispers at the edge of hearing. The Sanctuary Protocol brings restoration — but it is not mercy. It is containment. What will your people do with this revelation? • "Follow the Miracle across the land, seeking answers at hot spots and cold scars." • "Unravel the Seal, and risk what was kept behind it." • "Preserve the Machine, and protect peace… at any cost." Your ideology shapes your perception. Your pawns will begin to dream. The world will start to change.

GameConditionDef.label: Echo Protocol
GameConditionDef.description:
A ghost of the past. A lesser flicker of the miracle system stirs—a faded echo, barely enough to hold back entropy. It does not remember why it intervenes, only that it must.
Colonists speak of warmth without fire, wounds closing as if time reversed itself, and a strange calm pressing down on the land. Animals gather quietly, predators cease their hunt, and even the most hardened raiders hesitate—if only for a breath.
This protocol is not the full sanctuary. It is a frayed process running long after its purpose was lost—triggered by localized suffering, triggered by unknown thresholds.
Some say these echoes are test pulses, remnants of a broken system still reaching out. Others believe they are warnings.
